latency.scene: Space Rogue original storyline screenshot replay; not a running game
latency.measured_path: exact source image available -> version OCR -> tracking/settling -> actual DeepSeek streamed translation -> native GDI paint completed
latency.method: Three sequential old/new pairs on the same machine and image; fresh process and empty database for every sample; versions use their own scheduling defaults; same official provider and model; context web search disabled in both.
latency.not_a_speed_guarantee: n=3 per version; network/provider variation and changed OCR/output text are uncontrolled. Pair 1 current version is slower. Never label these values game FPS, pure OCR time, or measured screen-to-monitor latency.
latency.excluded_failed_capture_probe: e2e-baseline15-a.json has no confirmed native paint and is not a successful end-to-end sample. .15 uses desktop capture, not WGC.

notes: The AI result is evaluated from the already recorded authorized API run, without another paid request.
100% here means zero edit differences for these 248 source characters only; no general-game or translation-quality percentage is claimed.
The earlier 58.06% local-model experiment used x ordering within each row. This report consistently uses the existing compare22.py (y,x) ordering; the measured local score is 57.661%.

claims_scope.baseline: Retained application 0.01.15, not raw third-party frameworks.
claims_scope.latency: Static pixels available to confirmed native paint, not screen-to-monitor. n=3/version, actual API, web context disabled.
claims_scope.accuracy: Fixed manual zones only; character transcription, not semantic translation quality or localization IoU.
claims_scope.font: Current synthetic native regression only; no paired 0.01.15 font comparison.

live_measurement.kind: Real running Windose game, WGC, local OCR, AI image refinement, web-assisted context, translation and GDI overlay
live_measurement.limit: Single live scene. Native paint observation excludes display scan-out; background search is model-selected, inspect its recorded status.

distribution_note: Version 0.01.27 adds optional CUDA OCR, background web context and group font fitting fixes. Historical real-API, screenshot and game measurements retain their 0.01.25 / 0.01.15 labels. This version has a separate simulated scheduling probe, not a real game/API latency measurement. See TEST_REPORT.json for current validation scope.

current_version_offline_probe.method: Three fresh-engine samples per version, httpx MockTransport. Simulated web context waits 300ms; display translation waits 15ms. Captures first display callback and completion; awaits background separately for accounting. This is a scheduling regression probe, not real API/game latency or OCR performance.

tests.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_context_agent25.py tests/test_context_latency27.py tests/test_translation.py tests/test_context_archive.py

limits: No new real API timing was measured.
The first request uses only already-available context; later requests can use completed search reference.
At most one background context request; total network capacity remains shared. max_concurrency=1 leaves web refresh deferred.
Existing .25 game observation included vision and web search; its 10138.5ms first callback cannot be fully attributed to web context from available timestamps.

current_version_cuda_ocr.scope: Fixed original screenshots to raw CUDA OCR output. No capture, AI, translation or overlay. Accuracy uses manual truth zones and NFKC whitespace-normalized Levenshtein distance.
current_version_cuda_ocr.limits: Client timing includes BMP/IPC/helper OCR; excludes capture, translation, overlay and monitor. No monotonic quality or all-game claim.

current_version_native_replay.kind: Native GDI replay of saved row geometry/translation; not a live-game test.
